text:
Capitulum Ecclesiae Cathedralis
Posnaniensis.
Wir machen durch gegenwärtiges allen und jeden
denen daran gelegen ist bekannt: daß Wir auf
die Bitte, der Parthei welche es angeht, das unten¬
geschriebene Privilegium, in welchem der Actus und
das Jahr enthalten ist, und welches in dem General
Capitulo des herl. Martini Anno 1767 approbiret aus
dem in unserm Archivo aufbewahrten Buche der Pri¬
vilegiorum gefunden heraus zu nehmen und in Forma
probanti zu extradiren befohlen haben. Dessen Inhalt
folgender ist Theodor auf Klewan und Zukow Fürst¬
von Czartorinski von Gottes und des heil. Apostoliischen
Stuhls-Gnaden Bischof von Posen und Warschau ma¬
chen allen insgesamt und einem jeden, dem hiervon
jetzt und in der Zukunft zu wissen zu kommen wird,
bekannt, daß die edlen Simeon und Apollonia Rzą¬
kowski den Eheleute bey Uns supplicando eingekom¬
men (angehalten) haben, daß Wir Ihnen eine
Hufe wüsten Ackers in dem zu Unserm Betscher
Schlüssel gehörenden Dorfe Głazewo gelegen
zugleich mit dem auf Kosten des Hofes erbaueten
Wohnhause und Scheune gegen jährlichen Zins
nach der Gewohnheit der andern Einwohner die¬
ses Dorffes zu überlassen und zu verkaufen
geruhen möchten. Da wir dieser Ihrer auf die
Vermehrung unseres gewißen Einkommens abzwek¬
kender bitte defereren, so haben Wir beschlossen
eben diese Hufe Acker zugleich mit der Woh¬
nung und der Scheune ebendenselben und Ihren
Sucessoribus zu überlassen und zu verkaufen, wie Wir
durch gegenwärtiges Privilegium in Ansehung
der auf vor gedachte Gebäude verwandten
Kosten für dreissig Ducaten in specie sage
30 Ducaten überlassen und verkaufen. Von
welcher mänlichen Hufe Acker eben diese andren
v. Rząkowskische Eheleute und denen Succesores sich ver¬
pflichten 130 fl. po. in zwoen Raten zu zahlen, neh¬
auf des Fest Johannis des Täufers 65 fl. und auf¬
des Fest der heil. 3 Könige des Kopfgeld und die Hi¬
bernen (Geld für die Soldaten im Winter) nach der Ge¬
wohnheit pünctlich an die Gemeine abzugeben: zur Bitte
auf des Głazewer Vorwerk viermahl im Jahre, des glei¬
chen zur Abräumung der Wiese Obsko genannt die durch
das Recht zu diesem Vorwerke hinzugefügt worden
ist, zugleich mit der Gemeine zu schicken werden, selbi¬
verbunden seyn. Für jede zwei Viertel Gerste alt
Neustceter Maaß soll eine Tonne Bier aus dem Bet¬
scher Brauhause erlaubt sein. Wir versprechen hiernach
in Unserm und Unserer hochlöbl. Successorum der Posner
Bischoffe Namen, das Wir vorgedachte edle von
Rządkowskische Eheleute von der Benutzung und
dem ruhigen Besitze auch die Successores dersel¬
ben, dieser Hufe Acker nicht entfernen werden,
noch auch irgend jemanden die Macht selbige zu
entfernen nicht erlauben Wir den, sondern
vielmehr bei dem jetzigen Privilegio unverrükt
erhalten, und auch Unsre hochg. Successores erhalten
werden. Die Rechte der Kirche und der Republi¬
que vorbehaltend Worauf Wir uns eigenhändig
unterschrieben zu mehrer Gültigkeit, und mit
dem Insiegel zu bestätigen befohlen haben.
Gegeben zu Dolsk d. 26ten Sepber Ano Domini
1766. Theodor Fürst v. Czartoryski Bischof in Posen
(L. S.) Ginlily ./. Andreas Miskowski D. C. P. Präsident

translation.en:
Capitulum Ecclesiae Cathedralis

Posnaniensis.

We make known by these presents to all and each whom it concerns: that We, upon the petition of the party whom it concerns, have ordered the privilege written below, in which the Actus and the year are contained, and which was approved in the General Capitulum of St. Martin in the year 1767, to be sought out and taken from the Book of the Privilegia preserved in Our Archivum, and to be extradited in Forma probanti. The content whereof is the following: Theodor of Klewan and Zukow, Prince of Czartorinski, by the grace of God and of the Holy Apostolic See Bishop of Posen and Warsaw, We make known to all together and to each single one to whose knowledge this shall come now and in the future, that the noble Simeon and Apollonia Rząkowski, the married couple, have come in before Us supplicando (have applied), that We might be pleased to make over and to sell to them one Hufe of waste arable land situate in the village of Głazewo belonging to Our Betsche key, together with the dwelling-house and barn built at the cost of the manor, against an annual rent according to the custom of the other inhabitants of this village. Since We defer to this their request, which tends to the increase of Our certain revenue, We have therefore resolved to make over and to sell this very Hufe of arable land together with the dwelling and the barn to the same persons and to their Sucessores, as We do by the present privilege make over and sell it, in respect of the costs expended upon the aforesaid buildings, for thirty ducats in specie, say 30 ducats. Of which manly Hufe of arable land these same other

v. Rząkowski married couple and their Successores bind themselves to pay 130 fl. po. in two instalments, namely 65 fl. on the Feast of John the Baptist, and on the Feast of the Holy Three Kings to render punctually to the community the head-money and the Hibernen (money for the soldiers in winter) according to custom: they shall likewise be bound to be sent, together with the community, to the labour-service on the Głazewo demesne farm four times in the year, and likewise to the clearing of the meadow called Obsko, which has by right been added to this demesne farm. For every two quarters of barley, old Neustcet measure, one tun of beer from the Betsche brewhouse shall be allowed. We promise hereafter, in Our name and in the name of Our most laudable Successores the Bishops of Posen, that We shall not remove the aforesaid all the von Rząkowski married couple from the use and quiet possession, nor likewise their Successores, of this Hufe of arable land, nor shall We permit anyone whomsoever the power to remove the same, but shall rather maintain them unmoved in the present privilege, and Our aforesaid Successores shall likewise maintain them. Reserving the rights of the Church and of the Republic. Whereupon We have signed with Our own hand, and for greater validity have ordered it to be confirmed with the seal. Given at Dolsk, the 26th of September, Anno Domini 1766. Theodor Prince v. Czartoryski, Bishop in Posen (L. S.) Ginlily ./. Andreas Miskowski D. C. P., President Capituli (L. S. Capitularis.)

(L. S.)

From the Book of the Privileges

of the Cathedral Church of Posen,

under the seal of the Most Reverend Chapter of that same Cathedral Church at Posen

The content whereof is the following: Theodor of Klewan and Zukow, Prince of Czartorinski, by the grace of God and of the Holy Apostolic See Bishop of Posen and Warsaw, We make known to all together and to each single one to whose knowledge this shall come now and in the future, that the noble Simeon and Apollonia Rząkowski, the married couple, have come in before Us supplicando (have applied), that We might be pleased to make over and to sell to them one Hufe of waste arable land situate in the village of Głazewo belonging to Our Betsche key, together with the dwelling-house and barn built at the cost of the manor, against an annual rent according to the custom of the other inhabitants of this village. Since We defer to this their request, which tends to the increase of Our certain revenue, We have therefore resolved to make over and to sell this very Hufe of arable land together with the dwelling and the barn to the same persons and to their Sucessores, as We do by the present privilege make over and sell it, in respect of the costs expended upon the aforesaid buildings, for thirty ducats in specie, say 30 ducats. Of which manly Hufe of arable land these same other

v. Rząkowski married couple and their Successores bind themselves to pay 130 fl. po. in two instalments, namely 65 fl. on the Feast of John the Baptist, and on the Feast of the Holy Three Kings to render punctually to the community the head-money and the Hibernen (money for the soldiers in winter) according to custom: they shall likewise be bound to be sent, together with the community, to the labour-service on the Głazewo demesne farm four times in the year, and likewise to the clearing of the meadow called Obsko, which has by right been added to this demesne farm. For every two quarters of barley, old Neustcet measure, one tun of beer from the Betsche brewhouse shall be allowed. We promise hereafter, in Our name and in the name of Our most laudable Successores the Bishops of Posen, that We shall not remove the aforesaid all the von Rząkowski married couple from the use and quiet possession, nor likewise their Successores, of this Hufe of arable land, nor shall We permit anyone whomsoever the power to remove the same, but shall rather maintain them unmoved in the present privilege, and Our aforesaid Successores shall likewise maintain them. Reserving the rights of the Church and of the Republic. Whereupon We have signed with Our own hand, and for greater validity have ordered it to be confirmed with the seal. Given at Dolsk, the 26th of September, Anno Domini 1766. Theodor Prince v. Czartoryski, Bishop in Posen (L. S.) Ginlily ./. Andreas Miskowski D. C. P., President Capituli (L. S. Capitularis.)

(L. S.)

From the Book of the Privileges

summary_en: Vidimated extract from the Privilege Book of the Posen cathedral chapter, issued in Forma probanti, reproducing Bishop Theodor Prince v. Czartoryski's privilege for the married couple Simeon and Apollonia Rząkowski: one Hufe of waste arable land in Głazewo, of the Betsche key, with manor-built dwelling-house and barn, sold for thirty ducats in specie, against 130 fl. po. yearly in two instalments of 65 fl., head-money and Hibernen, fourfold labour-service on the Głazewo demesne and clearing of the Obsko meadow, with beer allowance and guarantee of quiet possession to their Successores.
summary_de: Vidimierter Auszug aus dem Privilegienbuch des Posener Domkapitels: Theodor Fürst v. Czartoryski, Bischof zu Posen, überlässt und verkauft auf Bitten der Eheleute Simeon und Apollonia Rząkowski eine wüste Hufe Ackerland im Dorf Głazewo (Schlüssel Betsche) samt herrschaftlich erbautem Wohnhaus und Scheune für 30 Ducaten in specie. Jährlich 130 fl. po. in zwei Raten von 65 fl., Kopfgeld und Hibernen, viermalige Hofdienste auf dem Vorwerk Głazewo sowie Räumung der Wiese Obsko; je zwei Viertel Gerste eine Tonne Bier aus der Betscher Brauerei. Besitzschutz für die Successores.
